name: Native RPC methods wired through all layers
instruction: New native-messaging RPC methods must be typed, forwarded, handled, and covered by both extension and Go tests.
relevant_when: Diff that adds, renames, or changes a native-messaging RPC method in extension/entrypoints/shared/rpc.ts, extension/entrypoints/background.ts, internal/cmd/serve.go, or related native RPC tests.
context: AGENTS.md defines the repository rule for adding native-messaging RPC methods: define request and response types, forward through sendNative, handle in Go, and cover both sides in tests.
scope_reason: The invariant depends on companion changes across TypeScript, Go, and tests in one pull request.

checklist.name: typed-and-forwarded
checklist.rule: For each new or changed RPC method, the diff includes matching TypeScript request/response types and background forwarding through the native messaging path, unless the method is exclusively internal to the host. Return not applicable if no native-messaging RPC method is added, renamed, or changed.

checklist.name: go-handler-present
checklist.rule: For each new or changed RPC method that the extension can call, the diff includes a matching Go handler in the native host. Return not applicable if no extension-callable native-messaging RPC method is added, renamed, or changed.

checklist.name: both-side-tests
checklist.rule: For each new or changed extension-callable RPC method, the diff includes or updates extension native RPC tests and Go command tests that cover the method's contract. Return not applicable if no extension-callable native-messaging RPC method is added, renamed, or changed.
